propositions: The plan-review criterion project.portability has an undifferentiated 'CI' matrix cell that cannot name 'no CI provider at all' as an alternate shape, leaving capabilities with GitHub-Actions-only triggers undetected.

A capability whose only trigger is a specific CI system (e.g., GitHub Actions schedule) without an operation-linked or in-process fallback is not portable and should fire a finding when the target project has no CI provider.

The criterion detection text in .rebar/prompts/plan-review-project-portability.md must split the matrix cell to list both 'CI under any provider (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, and others)' and 'projects with NO CI provider at all', with a new rule stating that a hard dependency on a specific CI system requires a fallback or is a finding.

Test pinning in test_project_portability_criterion.py and test_project_portability_docs.py must assert both the updated matrix cell string and the new no-CI-provider rule so the detection cannot be silently dropped.
AGENTS.md must surface the new rule via a one-line pointer bullet linking to rebar explain project.portability and docs/plan-review-gate.md without restating rubric text.
